title: Australian Pretzel Salad
description: A twist on a classic salad, combining the crunch of pretzels with fresh Australian ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the pretzel rods on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cheddar cheese, and toasted pretzel rods.
In a small bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar, olive oil, salt, and rosemary.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Squeeze the juice of the lively lemons over the salad and toss again.
Sprinkle the minced garlic over the salad and serve.
